consequence.statement: New opt-in option; nothing changes for operators who do not set it.

original.statement: A new cert-manager controller flag --extra-certificate-annotations was added, letting operators specify annotation keys to copy from Ingress or Gateway resources to the resulting Certificate.

decision.reason: [ev-da53ded48367] describes a newly added controller option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, that "allows you to specify" which annotation keys get copied from an Ingress or Gateway to the Certificate. So it is opt-in and only adds a capability. The evidence says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or changes by default when the option is not set. That supports consequence kind none (informational) with low severity.
